corridor: Use unmodified original source and fixed physical seed columns. Allow at most ceil(one minimum contacted staffspace) successive empty rows; trim outer gaps. Require at least6spaces total span and80% occupied rows. Fixed columns prevent jumping to a nearby stem. This first version may abstain on strongly curved vertical shafts.
proposals: Rows whose original horizontal run through the shaft is compact(.75..2.2spaces) and extends at least.35space beyond the shaft seed body neighborhoods. Group proposal rows with gaps <=.65space; try center offsets±.25space around group center, horizontal centers0/±.45space fromshaft, ellipse radiiX .6/.75space andY .28/.38space, angles-30/0/30degrees. This is a bounded development recognizer, not full musical OCR.
originalSourceProof: At least85% ellipse boundary support (one-pixel neighborhood) and65% in everyquadrant; filled interior82% dark OR hollow interior at least50% white. Outside ellipse1.15..1.65 normalized radius, excluding only physicalshaft columns,75% sourcewhite. At least2 directly attached compact original rows outside the shaft must bridge to the shaft, avoiding staffline-only contact. Retain measured fitted envelope plus one pixel; body witness scores and original-coordinate overlays recorded.
spanPairs: Merge duplicate overlapping body hypotheses by best source score. At least two distinct directly attached accepted bodies on one shaft, separated by more thanone staffspace and contacting at least2 source staff cores. Preserve the bounding source envelope head-to-head only; internal continuing corridor beyond outer accepted bodies is excluded. Record bodies, trace, missing rows and contacted staffIDs.
invariant: New flagged components appended only at final retainMusicalEvidence=true stage; ordinary/old alternatives invariant and existing crop rectangles can only expand. No structural-core or currentbody-check changes.
limitations: Parametric body shapes can miss real faint/thick/irregular heads, and enclosed tie/barline pockets can resemble hollow heads. These remain explicit reject/abstain cases to test; no local threshold changes after outputs within V1.
